name: nnFoundation
plain: nnFoundation (DKFZ): self-supervised 3D encoders (a convolutional one and a vision transformer) pre-trained on 2.1 million CT, MRI and PET volumes; they turn a volume into feature maps for your own medical models. Share-alike weights (CC-BY-SA-4.0): fine-tuned models keep the licence.
summary: nnFoundation (Harsy et al. 2026): DKFZ's self-supervised 3D radiology foundation encoders, pre-trained with nnssl on 2.1 M CT, MRI and PET volumes. `nnfoundation-cnn` is the ResEnc-L U-Net encoder (6 stages, 32-320 channels, strides 1-32), `nnfoundation-vit` the Primus ViT (40 layers, width 1056, 8³ patch tokens, fixed 192³ input). Gives the encoder feature maps of a z-score normalised volume for fine-tuning or frozen-feature use; the MAE decoder is not included.

papers.title: Primus: Enforcing Attention Usage for 3D Medical Image Segmentation

limitations: Kernels peak allocated is equal to portable, but the cuDNN workspace next to the large conv maps (1.4 GiB and 0.3 GiB workspaces) fragments the allocator: peak reserved is ~580 MiB above portable.
task_io: Input: a CT volume `[D, H, W]` in Hounsfield units and its voxel spacing in mm (`volume.read_nifti` reads both from a NIfTI file). Output: a class index per voxel `[D, H, W]` on the input grid (0 = background). Encoder models (nnFoundation) take a CT or MRI volume and give its encoder feature maps.

variants.name: nnfoundation-cnn

licence.training_note: 2.1 million CT, MRI and PET volumes from 125 institutional and public datasets (Human Radiome Project); the dataset list is not published with the weights. Share-alike: models fine-tuned from these weights are adapted material under CC-BY-SA-4.0.
notes: share-alike: weights CC-BY-SA-4.0; fine-tuned or adapted weights keep this licence

quality.title: TotalSegmentator test subset (8 CT cases), encoder features vs the original fp32: cosine (worst case) / relative L2
quality.protocol: A small subset of real CT cases of the TotalSegmentator dataset (not the full test split), each run at its card's spacing (1.5 or 3 mm) in the same pipeline; mean over the cases of the Dice (0 to 1) averaged over the classes present, against the ground-truth segmentations (vertebrae_L6 of the subset has no counterpart and is skipped). Original = TotalSegmentator 2.18.0, default fp16 autocast. Encoder models have no task head, so they are judged by their output: the encoder feature maps against the original fp32 maps (cosine similarity, worst case over the cases and the mean over the maps; relative L2 error, mean). Original (fp32) is the reference; the original fp16 row shows the error the original itself has in half precision.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1.8e-06 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.15 % and p99 <= 1.1 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output `features`).
